description: Source code for CKEditor plugin dialog for configuring HTML form elements, including setup, content management, and form attribute handling.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the form dialog when shown, loading existing form data if editing an existing form element.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the creation or updating of the form element when the dialog is confirmed.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, setting up attribute auto-setup and auto-commit functions for form fields.
